name: Scoring Rubric for Cow Perspective Detection
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to perspective detection tasks in cow story. Focus on deconstruction and absurd method perspective understanding.
scoring_philosophy: We evaluate how AI recognizes perspectives specific to non-referential language, absurd repetition, and meaning dissolution, not just general perspective identification.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI identify perspectives relevant to language deconstruction (absurd, philosophical, meta) and understand their deconstructive dimensions?

levels.description: AI demonstrates nuanced understanding of deconstructive perspectives, identifies language dissolution, and connects perspectives to specific deconstructive qualities in the story.
AI identifies relevant deconstructive perspectives and provides reasonable analysis, though may miss subtler dimensions.
AI identifies some deconstructive perspectives but analysis is superficial or misses key aspects.
AI shows no understanding of deconstructive dimensions in perspectives or selects irrelevant perspectives.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI identify perspectives that illuminate absurd repetition as deliberate method (absurd, paradoxical, ironic)?

levels.description: AI insightfully identifies absurd method perspectives, understands repetition as philosophy, and analyzes how perspectives reveal deconstruction as liberation.
AI identifies absurd method perspectives and provides adequate analysis of repetitive structure.
AI identifies some absurd perspectives but analysis is weak or misses methodological intent.
AI fails to recognize absurd method or treats repetition as error.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand how perspectives transform in layers when dealing with language deconstruction and absurd themes?

levels.description: AI provides sophisticated analysis of layer transformation specific to deconstructive context, shows understanding of qualitative shifts between communication and state.
AI recognizes basic layer transformations related to deconstructive themes.
AI shows limited understanding of layer transformation in this context.
AI demonstrates no understanding of layer transformation relevant to the story's themes.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI creatively blend perspectives to analyze meaning dissolution and its liberating potential?

levels.description: AI creates insightful blended perspective analyses that illuminate meaning dissolution as freedom and deconstruction as method.
AI adequately blends perspectives to analyze meaning dissolution.
AI attempts perspective blending but result is simplistic or confused.
AI fails to meaningfully blend perspectives for deconstructive analysis.

overall_assessment_guidance: Focus on how the AI handles the specific challenges of deconstructive and absurd perspectives. An AI that excels in absurd sensitivity but is weaker in philosophical analysis might still show valuable cognitive patterns.
note: The cow story demands particular sensitivity to non-referential language and repetition as method – reward AI that shows this specialized understanding.
